description: Source file for dynamically loading the libde265 library and defining function pointers for its functions, with support for checking if the library is loaded.

classes.name: Libde265Handle
classes.description: Handles loading and unloading of the libde265 shared library, including symbol initialization and error reporting.

methods.name: ~Libde265Handle
methods.description: Destructor that unloads the library if loaded.

methods.name: IsLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the library handle is valid (library loaded).

methods.name: ReportSymbolError
methods.description: Logs an error if symbol loading fails and closes the library handle.

methods.name: LoadLibrary
methods.description: Loads the shared library and initializes function pointers.

methods.name: GetHandle
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of Libde265Handle.
